info.title: OpenVibe.Vision API
info.description: Routes of OpenVibe.Vision as the OpenVibe contracts describe them (openvibe-contracts 0.261.0): each operation lists the capabilities it performs; a token for the service's audience must carry one of them unless the route is open. Generated by openvibe-contracts lib/openapi.js; do not edit.

post.summary: Write editable alt text for an image on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/alt returns one short sentence about the scene, objects and action, never about a person.
post.description: **vision.alt.write** (first-party): Write editable alt text for an image on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/alt returns one short sentence about the scene, objects and action, never about a person. The answer has passed noLooks; the receipt names the engine, cost and latency. Rooms use it for Pics, Media and Chat uploads.

post.summary: Ask or describe an image on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/ask and /api/v1/describe take an image (multipart, data URL or public URL), a question, a task (ask, describe, identify, count, translate, ocr
post.description: **vision.image.ask** (first-party): Ask or describe an image on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/ask and /api/v1/describe take an image (multipart, data URL or public URL), a question, a task (ask, describe, identify, count, translate, ocr) and a mode (auto, local, ai). A read question is answered by the local OCR reader first; everything else goes through OpenVibe.AI, whose provenance the answer reports. In auto mode a read question also works anonymously; any other task needs a signed-in person or this capability.

get.summary: Read OpenVibe.Vision's aggregate comparison results: GET /api/v1/benchmarks groups compare samples by task, engine, provider and model with sample counts, mean latency and mean cost, with no subject,
get.description: **vision.benchmarks.read** (first-party): Read OpenVibe.Vision's aggregate comparison results: GET /api/v1/benchmarks groups compare samples by task, engine, provider and model with sample counts, mean latency and mean cost, with no subject, image or answer text. Public.

post.summary: Run OpenVibe.Vision's side-by-side comparison: POST /api/v1/compare runs the local reader and up to three AI model hints on the same image and returns each row with its success, text, cost and latency.
post.description: **vision.model.compare** (first-party): Run OpenVibe.Vision's side-by-side comparison: POST /api/v1/compare runs the local reader and up to three AI model hints on the same image and returns each row with its success, text, cost and latency. The requested model is a hint; OpenVibe.AI's own provenance is what each row reports.

post.description: **vision.image.ask** (first-party): Ask or describe an image on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/ask and /api/v1/describe take an image (multipart, data URL or public URL), a question, a task (ask, describe, identify, count, translate, ocr) and a mode (auto, local, ai). In auto mode a read question also works anonymously; any other task needs a signed-in person or this capability.

post.summary: Identity-free face blurring on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/faces/blur returns a redacted PNG derivative and the blurred count in X-Faces-Blur.
post.description: **vision.face.blur** (first-party): Identity-free face blurring on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/faces/blur returns a redacted PNG derivative and the blurred count in X-Faces-Blur. No template is stored and the original is discarded; anyone may use it.

post.summary: Match faces against one channel's opted-in adult cast roster for OpenVibe.Live: POST /api/v1/faces/cast/match.
post.description: **vision.face.cast.match** (first-party): Match faces against one channel's opted-in adult cast roster for OpenVibe.Live: POST /api/v1/faces/cast/match. The caller is the Live service token scoped to that channel (its channel_id claim must equal the body's channel) and must hold this capability. A non-consented person is never matched and the answer does not say whether they exist.

get.summary: Read your own cast tags on OpenVibe.Vision: GET /api/v1/faces/cast/tags lists the named channel and media reference for each tag the person's own cast consent produced.
get.description: **vision.face.cast.read** (first-party): Read your own cast tags on OpenVibe.Vision: GET /api/v1/faces/cast/tags lists the named channel and media reference for each tag the person's own cast consent produced. Revoking the consent removes them.

get.summary: Read, grant and revoke purpose-scoped face or voice consent on OpenVibe.Vision: GET /api/v1/faces/consents and /consents/text, POST /consents/:feature with the signed current text, and DELETE /consent
get.description: **vision.face.consent.manage** (first-party): Read, grant and revoke purpose-scoped face or voice consent on OpenVibe.Vision: GET /api/v1/faces/consents and /consents/text, POST /consents/:feature with the signed current text, and DELETE /consents/:feature, which revokes and erases the template and derived data in one transaction. A person manages only their own record; the record says whose face or voice, the scope, expiry and how it was revoked (vision.consent@1).

post.summary: Identity-free face detection on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/faces/detect counts faces and returns their boxes and scores with local YuNet.
post.description: **vision.face.detect** (first-party): Identity-free face detection on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/faces/detect counts faces and returns their boxes and scores with local YuNet. It stores no template, names no one and needs no consent; anyone may use it.

post.summary: Verify yourself against your own enrolled template on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/faces/enrol/verify and /api/v1/faces/verify.
post.description: **vision.face.verify.self** (first-party): Verify yourself against your own enrolled template on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/faces/enrol/verify and /api/v1/faces/verify. Refused with faces.consent_required without that person's verify consent, the same answer whether or not a template exists; a match alone unlocks nothing.

post.summary: Find yourself in your own private uploads on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/faces/media, GET /api/v1/faces/media/:id and POST /api/v1/faces/find.
post.description: **vision.face.find.self** (first-party): Find yourself in your own private uploads on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/faces/media, GET /api/v1/faces/media/:id and POST /api/v1/faces/find. Refused with faces.consent_required without find consent, the same answer whether or not any media exists; results are private links to the caller's own rows.

get.description: **vision.models.read** (first-party): Read OpenVibe.Vision's model menu: GET /api/v1/models returns the AI route's offered provider:model hints, the configured hints and the local engines present, with no subject data. Public; OpenVibe.AI's router is still the authority.

post.summary: Find moments in a stream or VOD on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/moments compares up to 30 timestamped frames with CLIP prompt embeddings and a histogram scene-change pass, returning scene changes and
post.description: **vision.video.moments** (first-party): Find moments in a stream or VOD on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/moments compares up to 30 timestamped frames with CLIP prompt embeddings and a histogram scene-change pass, returning scene changes and candidate moments. A candidate is a suggestion for Live or Media to accept.

post.summary: Read text from an image with OpenVibe.Vision's local Tesseract 5 reader: POST /api/v1/ocr returns the text, mean confidence and word boxes at zero cost, anonymously.
post.description: **vision.text.read** (first-party): Read text from an image with OpenVibe.Vision's local Tesseract 5 reader: POST /api/v1/ocr returns the text, mean confidence and word boxes at zero cost, anonymously. `fallback` asks OpenVibe.AI only when the local pass found no usable text, and that fallback needs a signed-in person or this capability.

post.summary: Match a product photo to offers on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/product describes the product only (never a person), embeds it with CLIP and returns candidate offers from OpenVibe.Deals and open.shoe
post.description: **vision.product.match** (first-party): Match a product photo to offers on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/product describes the product only (never a person), embeds it with CLIP and returns candidate offers from OpenVibe.Deals and open.shoes with their score and URL. A candidate is not a verified price.

post.summary: Read a receipt on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/receipt returns the store, line items and total the local OCR reader extracted; `fallback` asks OpenVibe.AI only when the local pass could not produce b
post.description: **vision.receipt.read** (first-party): Read a receipt on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/receipt returns the store, line items and total the local OCR reader extracted; `fallback` asks OpenVibe.AI only when the local pass could not produce both. OpenVibe.Food decides what enters a pantry.

post.summary: Run OpenVibe.Vision's UI check: POST /api/v1/ui-check takes HTML, a public URL or a screenshot plus an optional viewport and returns overflow, cut-off text, low contrast, overlap and layering findings
post.description: **vision.ui.check** (first-party): Run OpenVibe.Vision's UI check: POST /api/v1/ui-check takes HTML, a public URL or a screenshot plus an optional viewport and returns overflow, cut-off text, low contrast, overlap and layering findings with counts and severity; GET /api/v1/ui-checks/:id reads a saved check. OpenVibe.Design's Arena is the caller today; a signed-in person may also use it. The check runs entirely on Vision's host (static HTML/CSS parsing, or OCR boxes and pixel sampling for a screenshot): it executes no JavaScript and fetches only a public URL through the SSRF guard.

post.summary: Watch a camera still on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/watch finds the requested classes (DETR labels, snow, delivery, package through CLIP, or a histogram scene change against previous_image) and retu
post.description: **vision.camera.watch** (first-party): Watch a camera still on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/watch finds the requested classes (DETR labels, snow, delivery, package through CLIP, or a histogram scene change against previous_image) and returns detections with confidence and boxes. Owner-granted camera alerting only; a watched class can raise vision.alert.

errors.problem.v1.title: Problem
errors.problem.v1.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable OpenVibe error code and trace identifiers. The legacy 'error' string is allowed during migration so existing clients keep working.

error.description: Deprecated compatibility field: same text as title/detail for clients that read {error}.

vision.alt-result.v1.title: VisionAltResult
vision.alt-result.v1.description: vision.alt-result@1: POST /api/v1/alt answers one short, editable alt-text sentence about the scene, objects and action, never about a person. The text has passed noLooks; the receipt says which engine answered and at what cost.

vision.answer-result.v1.title: VisionAnswerResult
vision.answer-result.v1.description: vision.answer-result@1: what POST /api/v1/ask, /describe and /ocr answer (`{ answer }`), and POST /api/v1/compare answers with `compare` rows and the local reader's summary added. Every AI-written text has passed noLooks: a look-naming answer is replaced, never repaired word by word.

vision.answer.v1.title: VisionAnswer
vision.answer.v1.description: vision.answer@1: one saved answer on OpenVibe.Vision. It names the engine, model, provider and route that actually answered (never a model hint), the reason it was chosen, the cost OpenVibe.AI reported, the measured latency and the confidence. No image bytes are stored: only a sha256 and the declared media type.

answer.description: Engine details, OCR words, provenance and any compare rows; never an image.

vision.ask-request.v1.title: VisionAskRequest
vision.ask-request.v1.description: vision.ask-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/ask and /api/v1/describe on OpenVibe.Vision. `task` is what the caller wants (ask, describe, identify, count, translate, ocr); `mode` is auto (local OCR first, then OpenVibe.AI), local (never a model) or ai. A read question (text, sign, receipt, label) is answered by the local OCR reader first in auto mode. `lang` is the Tesseract language and `model` is a provider:model hint AI may ignore.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.

vision.benchmarks.v1.title: VisionBenchmarks
vision.benchmarks.v1.description: vision.benchmarks@1: GET /api/v1/benchmarks aggregates compare samples per task, engine, provider and model with sample counts and mean latency and cost. No subject, image or answer text is included.

vision.compare-request.v1.title: VisionCompareRequest
vision.compare-request.v1.description: vision.compare-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/compare. One image runs through the local reader and up to three AI hints; the requested model is a hint only, and each row reports the provider and model OpenVibe.AI says answered.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.

vision.consent-request.v1.title: VisionConsentRequest
vision.consent-request.v1.description: vision.consent-request@1: POST /api/v1/faces/consents/:feature. The caller signs the current text (`text_version` must match this server's), names themself (`signed_name`), and for cast must confirm they are an adult; library grouping is refused outside the host's allowed regions. A repeat of an active consent changes nothing.

vision.consent.v1.title: VisionConsent
vision.consent.v1.description: vision.consent@1: one consent record on OpenVibe.Vision. It says whose face or voice it is (`subject`), the modality, the purpose-scoped feature and scope (a channel or a library), who signed which text version, when it was granted, when it expires, and how and when it was revoked. Face matching tools refuse without an active record for that person, with the same answer whether or not the person exists. Templates are deleted when the purpose ends and at the latest three years after the last use (BIPA); a revoked audit record is deleted one year after the purpose ends (CUBI).

subject.description: The person whose face or voice this consent covers.

scope.description: Empty means the person's own account; a cast grant names one channel, a library grant the library it applies to.

granted_by.description: The person who signed; the subject themself, or a guardian where the law allows.

expires_at.description: When the consent stops applying on its own; null when it lasts until revoked.

revoked_by.description: How it was revoked: by the person, by the retention job, or with the account.

retention_until.description: The outer limit the record and derived data may exist: three years after last use, or one year after the purpose ended.

erased.description: True once the template and derived results this consent covered are gone.

vision.face-blur.v1.title: VisionFaceBlur
vision.face-blur.v1.description: vision.face-blur@1: POST /api/v1/faces/blur answers a redacted PNG derivative and the number of faces blurred in X-Faces-Blur. Identity-free, no template, and the original is never stored.

vision.face-cast-match-request.v1.title: VisionFaceCastMatchRequest
vision.face-cast-match-request.v1.description: vision.face-cast-match-request@1: POST /api/v1/faces/cast/match, called by OpenVibe.Live with a service token scoped to one channel (vision.face.cast.match). It matches only that channel's opted-in adult roster; a person who has not enrolled for this channel cannot appear, and the answer does not say whether they exist.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.

vision.face-cast-match.v1.title: VisionFaceCastMatch
vision.face-cast-match.v1.description: vision.face-cast-match@1: the matches inside one channel's consented roster, each with a score and box. No other subject is named and no non-roster face is described.

vision.face-detection.v1.title: VisionFaceDetection
vision.face-detection.v1.description: vision.face-detection@1: POST /api/v1/faces/detect, an identity-free YuNet privacy tool. It counts faces and returns their boxes and scores; it stores no template, names no one and needs no consent. Anyone may use it.

vision.face-enrol-request.v1.title: VisionFaceEnrolRequest
vision.face-enrol-request.v1.description: vision.face-enrol-request@1: POST /api/v1/faces/enrol/:feature. `feature` is verify (1:1 verification of yourself), find (search your own uploads) or cast (an adult tagging named streams); each needs its own signed consent first, and cast also names the channel scope.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.

vision.face-find-result.v1.title: VisionFaceFindResult
vision.face-find-result.v1.description: vision.face-find-result@1: POST /api/v1/faces/find lists the caller's own private uploads that match their enrolled self-search template, as private links and scores. It requires find consent; without it the answer is faces.consent_required whether or not any media exists.

vision.face-library-group.v1.title: VisionFaceLibraryGroup
vision.face-library-group.v1.description: vision.face-library-group@1: one private face cluster in a person's own Vision library: the media it came from, the group it was merged into, an optional label and whether the person excluded it. It never leaves that person's library.

vision.face-library-request.v1.title: VisionFaceLibraryRequest
vision.face-library-request.v1.description: vision.face-library-request@1: POST /api/v1/faces/library/cluster (region-gated), GET /library/groups and POST /library/correct. `action` is cluster (default), exclude, merge or split; `ids` names up to 100 of the caller's own clusters; `region` is a jurisdiction code the host allows. Unknown faces stay unlabelled.

vision.face-library-result.v1.title: VisionFaceLibraryResult
vision.face-library-result.v1.description: vision.face-library-result@1: clustering and group reads answer the caller's own private face groups as an array; a correction answers the action and how many clusters it updated.

vision.face-tag-list.v1.title: VisionFaceTagList
vision.face-tag-list.v1.description: vision.face-tag-list@1: GET /api/v1/faces/cast/tags answers the caller's own cast tags, newest first, as a bare array. Empty when they have not consented to cast matching.

vision.face-tag.v1.title: VisionFaceTag
vision.face-tag.v1.description: vision.face-tag@1: one cast tag on a stream: which subject, which channel, which private media reference and when. GET /api/v1/faces/cast/tags lists the caller's own tags; revoking the cast consent removes them.

vision.face-verify.v1.title: VisionFaceVerify
vision.face-verify.v1.description: vision.face-verify@1: POST /api/v1/faces/verify compares this person's own verification attempt with their enrolled template. It always requires that person's verify consent; without it the answer is faces.consent_required whether or not a template exists. A match alone never unlocks anything: liveness and a second factor are separate.

vision.find-request.v1.title: VisionFindRequest
vision.find-request.v1.description: vision.find-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/index and of GET or POST /api/v1/find. `index` stores a scoped CLIP embedding for one of the caller's own items (`item_id`, optional `result_url`); `find` searches only the caller's own private index, by words (`q`) or by an example image. No public image index is ever built.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.

vision.find-result.v1.title: VisionFindResult
vision.find-result.v1.description: vision.find-result@1: POST /api/v1/index and GET/POST /api/v1/find answer a scoped private search over the caller's own indexed items: `results` (item_id, result_url, score) only, no one else's rows and no public index.

vision.image-request.v1.title: VisionImageRequest
vision.image-request.v1.description: vision.image-request@1: one image for OpenVibe.Vision's one-shot tools, as a data URL or a public URL. The multipart form field `image` carries the same bytes. Private tools (find, index, watch, moments) accept only uploaded bytes or a data URL, never an unverified source URL.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.

vision.models.v1.title: VisionModels
vision.models.v1.description: vision.models@1: GET /api/v1/models names the AI route's offered provider:model hints, the configured hints and the local engines present, without any subject data. OpenVibe.AI's router remains the authority: this is a menu, not a promise.

vision.moments-request.v1.title: VisionMomentsRequest
vision.moments-request.v1.description: vision.moments-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/moments. Up to 30 timestamped frames are compared with CLIP prompt embeddings; a histogram jump marks a scene change. VOD and stream chapters come from this.

vision.moments-result.v1.title: VisionMomentsResult
vision.moments-result.v1.description: vision.moments-result@1: POST /api/v1/moments answers scene changes and candidate moments (timestamp, matching prompt, score) for up to 30 frames. A moment is a suggestion: the room decides whether it becomes a clip or a chapter.

vision.ocr-request.v1.title: VisionOcrRequest
vision.ocr-request.v1.description: vision.ocr-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/ocr. The local Tesseract 5 reader runs on Vision's host and costs nothing; `fallback` asks OpenVibe.AI only when the local pass found no usable text, which needs a signed-in person or a service token holding vision.ocr.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.

vision.product-request.v1.title: VisionProductRequest
vision.product-request.v1.description: vision.product-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/product. The image is embedded locally with CLIP; `allow_rerank` lets one routed model reorder the candidate offers. Candidates come from OpenVibe.Deals and open.shoes; Vision never invents a price.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.

vision.product-result.v1.title: VisionProductResult
vision.product-result.v1.description: vision.product-result@1: POST /api/v1/product answers a description of the product only (never a person), the CLIP embedding, and candidate offers from OpenVibe.Deals and open.shoes with their score, price and URL. A room must not treat a candidate as a price it verified.

vision.receipt-request.v1.title: VisionReceiptRequest
vision.receipt-request.v1.description: vision.receipt-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/receipt. The local OCR reader extracts line items and a total; `fallback` asks OpenVibe.AI only when the local pass could not produce both.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.

vision.receipt-result.v1.title: VisionReceiptResult
vision.receipt-result.v1.description: vision.receipt-result@1: POST /api/v1/receipt answers the store, the line items and the total the local OCR reader read (or the routed fallback read), with `raw_text` when the local pass produced it. OpenVibe.Food decides what enters a pantry; Vision returns the reading.

vision.ui-check-request.v1.title: VisionUiCheckRequest
vision.ui-check-request.v1.description: vision.ui-check-request@1: the JSON body of POST /api/v1/ui-check on OpenVibe.Vision (Design's Arena and signed-in people; HTML, URL and screenshot checks also work anonymously). Send exactly one source: `html` with the markup, `url` with a public http(s) page, `image` with a data URL, or `image_url` with a public image URL. The multipart form field `image` is the same screenshot source. `viewport` defaults to 1280x800 and is clamped to 160..10000; the check executes no JavaScript and fetches only a public URL through the SSRF guard.

html.description: The HTML to check, including any inline CSS.

url.description: A public page to fetch and check.

image.description: A screenshot as an image data URL.

vision.ui-check-result.v1.title: VisionUiCheckResult
vision.ui-check-result.v1.description: vision.ui-check-result@1: the answer of POST /api/v1/ui-check and GET /api/v1/ui-checks/:id on OpenVibe.Vision. `check` names the engine that ran (static HTML/CSS or a screenshot through OCR boxes and pixels), the viewport, every finding with its stable kind and severity, and the summary the saved row keeps. No image bytes are returned; a screenshot is identified only by its sha256.

vision.watch-request.v1.title: VisionWatchRequest
vision.watch-request.v1.description: vision.watch-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/watch (owner-granted camera alerts). `classes` names 1–20 things to look for (snow, delivery, package, a DETR label, or "scene change"); `previous_image` is required for a scene change and is compared by histogram.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.

vision.watch-result.v1.title: VisionWatchResult
vision.watch-result.v1.description: vision.watch-result@1: POST /api/v1/watch answers the requested classes found in a camera still (DETR labels, snow/delivery/package through CLIP, or a histogram scene change), each with a confidence and, for an object, a box.

openvibeToken.description: An OpenVibe Network token for this service: a person's token, an app token (client credentials, audience of the service) or a first-party service token. Its `cap` claim must include the capability the operation names.
